_note: Adversarial re-check of retriage-0..3. Every NOW_FIXABLE was assumed wrong until the record text + src/rules code forced otherwise. Every NOT_A_GAP was checked against the live data. A sample of STILL_BLOCKED was re-tested against the four new lanes.

rulings.why: Text is 'You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.' fullCasterSlots (spellcasting.ts:33) sets slots[10]=1 at level>=19, and build.ts:2554 add() does `entry.slots[r].max += n` only when the rank already exists — so byRank {"10":1} yields exactly 2, never sets a total, and can only apply to a level-20 wizard. spellSlotBonus is declared on Feat (types.ts:324) and collected for feats at build.ts:2531; byRank is read at build.ts:2560 and short-circuits the perRank spread. Record currently has no spellSlotBonus, so this is a pure add.

Text 'You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.' Sorcerer is a full caster (slots[10]=1 at 19+), spontaneous entry -> slots[10].max 1->2. Value adds ONE, matching the printed word 'additional'. Verified no existing spellSlotBonus on the record.

Verified this is the level-20 DRUID FEAT ('You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot'), not the 19th-level feature that creates the capstone slot — so byRank {"10":1} increments an existing rank rather than creating one. core.json confirms feats/hierophants-power, level 20, spellSlotBonus undefined.

core.json feats/maker-of-miracles level 20: 'You are a conduit for truly deific power. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.' Cleric prepared entry has prepared[10] built from fullCasterSlots at 19+, and add() pushes exactly one empty prepared slot. Exact match.
Level-20 oracle feat, printed 'an additional 10th-rank spell slot'. Oracle is a full caster; spontaneous slots[10].max 1->2. No over-grant (adds 1).
Level-20 witch feat, printed 'an additional 10th-rank spell slot'. Witch prepared entry has rank 10 at level 19+. byRank adds one.
Level-20 bard feat, printed 'an additional 10th-rank spell slot'. Bard spontaneous entry slots[10].max 1->2. Adds one, not a total.

Verdict NOW_FIXABLE is right and the lane is right, but the VALUE is incomplete: 'all dwarven weapons in which you are trained' is under-covered. core.json holds ten level-0 dwarf-trait base weapons — clan-dagger, clan-pistol, dwarven-dorn-dergar, dwarven-scattergun, dwarven-war-axe, dwarven-waraxe, long-hammer, wrecker, wrecker-melee, wrecker-ranged — and the proposed list omits dwarven-war-axe and the two wrecker combination sub-forms. That is inconsistent with the same author's own elven fix (which correctly listed three-peaked-tree plus -melee and -ranged) and with the monastic-weaponry precedent (bow-staff / -melee / -ranged). A character wielding the dwarven-war-axe record or either wrecker form would get nothing. Magic specific dwarf weapons (axe-of-the-dwarven-lords, animate-dreamer, skysunder, immolation-clan-pistol) are correctly excluded — base-weapon-only is the registry norm.

Lane verified (featGrants.ts:116, applied build.ts:2477) and the feat is absent from the registry. Weapon list checked against core.json: the elf-trait BASE weapons are exactly dawnsilver-tree, elven-branched-spear, elven-curve-blade, three-peaked-tree + three-peaked-tree-melee + three-peaked-tree-ranged — all six present, combination sub-forms included. morning-glow (lvl 14), soulcutter (lvl 15) and soulcutter-heroic (artifact) are specific magic weapons, correctly left out. Base martial ids longbow/composite-longbow/longsword/rapier/shortbow/composite-shortbow all exist and match the printed list.

captain-dedication is a FEAT, so FEAT_PICK_GRANTS[featId] is consulted at build.ts:2177. Text names exactly two options, which is the documented `ids` form; pickableFeats short-circuits on spec.ids (featPickGrants.ts:115) so the vestigial maxLevel:1 is inert and harmless. Both group-impression and group-coercion exist in core.feats. Grants exactly ONE feat — no over-grant, and the 'if you already have both' fallback is correctly left unmodelled rather than guessed. Caveat (not a defect): the dedicated-follower half is argued in the prose but is NOT in the fix object, so applying this fix alone leaves the follower ungranted.

It is a feat, so lane 3 reaches it. I enumerated every level-1 druid-trait feat in core.json and its prerequisites: exactly seven list an order — animal-companion(animal), fire-lung(flame), leshy-familiar(leaf), shore-step(wave), steadying-stone(stone), storm-born(storm), untamed-form(untamed). The proposed ids are precisely that set, no more and no less; cultivation and spore have no level-1 order-prereq feat in the data, so nothing was dropped. One feat granted, not a pool — no over-grant. Repeatability limits a second take to storing one pick (pickFeatChoices is Record<string,string>, build.ts:188), but that under-serves rather than over-grants and matches shipped repeatable entries like multifarious-muse.

Note: the fix's kind label 'companionGrant' is outside the four kinds the task prescribed, and the lane is pre-existing rather than one of the four new ones — but the record does still need this registry row, so NOW_FIXABLE stands.

ModeDef.resistances (types.ts:1407) and ModeDef.feats (types.ts:1389) both exist, and deriveDefenses consumes active-mode resistances at derive.ts:762-767, resolving the value through resolveFormula (derive.ts:801). The formula string 'floor(@actor.level/2)' is used verbatim by shipped data (feats/necromantic-resistance), and the grammar (floor/ceil/max/min) parses it. Value matches 'cold and fire resistance equal to half your level' — no max(1,...) invented, since the printed minimum-1 applies only to the Wisdom fire damage, which correctly rides in `note` (it is a target-side rider the sheet does not own). Gate present (feats: [...]), so the mode will surface. StanceDef has resistances but no resistIfFeat sibling to senseIfFeat (types.ts:1462-1468), so writing it on stoked-flame-stance would give it to every monk in the stance — the mode is the only non-over-granting expression. Catalog entries get predefined:true automatically via CATALOG_MODES (modes.ts:206), and category 'Monk' already exists (cat-mountain-stance).

Same printed text as inner-fire-monk (verified in core.json, the Secrets of Magic reprint) and the same ModeDef with both ids in its `feats` gate, so it is correctly the SAME row, not a second one. Re-tested against lane 1 and the block holds for a stronger reason than stated. Text is 'You gain a SINGLE 10th-rank spell slot' (creating a rank), and add() only mutates ranks that already exist (build.ts:2554-2555). animistPreparedSlots (spellcasting.ts:86) loops r=1..9, so the prepared entry has no rank 10 — byRank {"10":1} is a silent no-op. Additional hazard the ruling missed: APPARITION_SLOTS DOES contain 10:1 at levels 19-20, so an entryId-less byRank could land on the animist's spontaneous apparition pool instead of the prepared one, which would be a wrong grant. STILL_BLOCKED confirmed.

Confirmed psychicSlots (spellcasting.ts:70) loops r=1..9 with an explicit comment that the psychic never gets a 10th-rank slot, and add() cannot create a missing rank. byRank {"10":1} would be inert. Needs a rank-creating slot lane. STILL_BLOCKED stands.
Same wall as infinite-mind, verified in spellcasting.ts and build.ts. STILL_BLOCKED stands.

Re-checked the printed text: the four slots are usable ONLY for conscious-mind spells, and the 5th-rank slot arrives at 18th. byRank {"1":1,"2":1,"3":1,"4":1} would hand a 14th-level psychic four UNRESTRICTED slots — an over-grant, which the task ranks worse than the gap. Needs slot restriction by spell source + a level-gated grant. STILL_BLOCKED stands.

Text confirms 'one additional spell slot of any spell level up to two levels below the highest' + curriculum-only. byRank names fixed ranks and cannot encode a player-chosen rank; perRank+exceptHighest:2 would add a slot at EVERY eligible rank. STILL_BLOCKED stands.
Text confirms 'two additional spell slots, each at half the highest rank' — a level-relative rank byRank cannot compute. STILL_BLOCKED stands.

Text confirms slots restricted to a named spell list that also MOVES rank (2nd -> 3rd at 10th -> 4th at 14th). byRank is static and unrestricted; writing it would over-grant at every level below the step. STILL_BLOCKED stands.
